text_blocks.snippet: To check your citizenship application status, you'll need your case receipt number and can then use the USCIS Case Status Online tool. You can also create a MyUSCIS account to access more detailed information about your case, including updates and correspondence.
Here's how to check your status:

list.snippet: Locate your receipt number: This is a 13-character identifier (3 letters followed by 10 numbers) provided by USCIS on your application receipt.
Go to the USCIS Case Status Online tool:
Enter your receipt number: Make sure to include all characters, including dashes if they are part of the number.
